name: variable-font-flex
description: A word lands while its variable-font weight and width axes flex from hairline-condensed to black-wide with per-character stagger; font-size eases inversely so the letterforms gain mass while the box holds.

vars.description: The word whose variable-font axes flex.
Which variable-font axes animate: weight, width, or both.
Seconds between per-character flex starts, clamped 0 to 0.25.
Word color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.
Optional departure. Default none: the carved word holds until the frame cuts.
